ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); note the driver's failed no-show claim on the driver record; if further unfounded no-show cancellations appear, refer the account for review.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver claims he waited at least 5 minutes at the pickup. GPS shows the vehicle reached the pickup area only around 21:29:00 and stayed within 200 m until cancellation at 21:30:55 — about 1 minute 55 seconds, below the >3-minute requirement of NS-1(iii). System records override the statement.
